title.narrative: Improving Healthcare Services in Somalia Project (“Damal Caafimaad”)

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to improve the coverage of essential health and nutrition services in Project areas and strengthen stewardship capacity of Ministries of Health.

The third Additional Financing (AF) in the amount of US$28 million will enable the Government of Somalia to sustain provision of critical essential health services through contracted non-governmental organizations (NGOs) in project supported regions and to renovate and equip six hospitals as well as construct the national cold chain storage facility. These civil works were originally planned under the COVID-19 Emergency Vaccination Project (P176956) approved on September 28, 2021. Unfortunately, they cannot be completed before the project's scheduled closing date of December 31, 2025 which is also the final closing date of the entire COVID-19 Strengthening Pandemic Response and Preparedness Multiphase Programmatic Approach (MPA). Given this situation, the proposal is to complete the implementation of these works under the Damal Caafimaad operation. Under the COVID-19 Project, the government contracted UNOPS to upgrade and renovate six hospitals: Bosaso, Dhuusamareeb, Kismayo General, Baidoa, Jowhar, and Forlanini with the primary goal of strengthening their capacity to respond to medical and health emergencies arising from the COVID-19 pandemic. The support included establishing emergency departments, creating isolation facilities, and providing essential medical equipment. The infrastructure investments are within the confines of existing hospital compounds in government owned land. Given the poor state of infrastructure, the hospitals are to be upgraded and adapted to better withstand climate-related shocks. Climate and disaster risk assessments were carried out for the individual sites and the hospitals designed incorporating measures to prevent and withstand climate shocks, including impacts of flooding, high winds; and extreme heat, to which Somalia is particularly vulnerable. In addition, all hospitals will be provided with solar power systems as primary or back-up power, replacing the use of hydrocarbon fuel-powered generators. In addition, the Project Paper seeks approval to restructure the Damal Caafimaad project to allow for (a) introduction of the renovation works with United Nations Office for Projects (UNOPS) as the implementing entity, (b) extension of the project closing date to December 12, 2026, and (c) revision of the results framework. The government submitted a request dated December 3, 2025 to facilitate the processing of the AF.

condition.narrative: Schedule 2, Section I, A (1a): Establish by no later than three (3) months after the Effective Date, and thereafter maintainthroughout the period of Project implementation, a high-level Project steering committee (“Project Steering Committee”).

Schedule 2, Section I, A (1b): Establish and thereafter maintain within the Federal Ministry of Health throughout the period ofProject implementation, a Project coordination implementation unit (variously the “Project Coordination and Implementation Unit or“PCIU”).

Schedule 2, Section I, A (1c): Establish by no later than six (6) months after the Effective Date, and thereafter maintainthroughout the period of Project implementation, a Project Leadership Committee.

Schedule 2, Section I, A (1d): Maintain, throughout the period of implementation of the Project, the EAFS Unit, established withinMoF's Office of Accountant General, with competent, experienced and qualified staff, in sufficient numbers and under terms ofreference acceptable to the Association.

Schedule 2, Section I, A (2b): Establish within the respective FMS-MoH, and thereafter maintain throughout the period Projectimplementation, a state Project team (“Project Management Team”).The hiring of the technical officers for these positions isunderway and expected to be completed by May 15th , 2022.

Schedule 2, Section I, B (1a): For purposes of carrying out the Project, and prior to the provision any funds and/or the financingof any activities implemented under the Project in/for any Federal Member State, the Recipient shall have entered into an agreementwith such Federal Member State (the “Subsidiary Agreement”), under terms and conditions acceptable to the Association, settingforth the obligations and responsibilities of the parties thereto (i.e. the Recipient and the Federal Member State) in theimplementation of the Project, in consistency with this Agreement, the ESCP and the Project Operations Manual.

Schedule 2, Section I, C (1a): No later than two months after the Effective Date prepare a Project operations manual, in form andsubstance satisfactory to the Association, containing detailed arrangements and procedures for implementation of the Project.

Schedule 2, Section I, E: The Recipient shall select and engage, by no later than four (4) months after the Effective Date, andthereafter retain throughout the period of implementation of the Project, the services of a duly qualified and experiencedmonitoring consultant satisfactory to the Association, under terms of reference acceptable to the Association, in order to: (a)develop and enhance the capacity the Federal Ministry of Health in monitoring; (b) monitor the delivery of high-impact health andnutrition services; and (ii) Project implementation.
Schedule 2, Section II, 1: The Recipient shall furnish to the Association each Project Report not later than forty-five (45) daysafter the end of each calendar quarter, covering the calendar quarter.

Schedule 2, Section II, D (a): Prepare and furnish to the Association on an annual basis, by no later than November 1st of eachyear, commencing on November 1, 2021, the annual work plan and budget containing all activities proposed to be included in theProject during the following Fiscal Year, and a proposed financing plan… the Annual Work Plan and Budget for the first year ofProject implementation shall be prepared by the Recipient by not later than three (3) months after the Effective Date.
